families.name: Original encoder
families.purpose: Local/global encoder design and isolated contracts
families.status: Implementation and component evidence recorded
families.limitations: Component tests are not whole-model training results.

families.name: Original concept module
families.purpose: Recurrence, writable state, steering, and end-to-end probes
families.status: Component experiment results recorded
families.limitations: ConceptCoreV2 is a component in whole-model V1, not whole-model V2.

families.name: Original decoder
families.purpose: Confined versus stacked decoder comparisons
families.status: Component results recorded
families.limitations: The original ZIP bundle stays local; its unpacked code and evidence are published.

families.name: V1 / THINKER-25M
families.purpose: Assemble and train the original encoder–concept–decoder model
families.status: Main final evaluation recorded; continuation paused
families.limitations: Dashboard links can reference later work. The continuation's PAUSE marker does not invalidate the main run's final evaluation.

families.name: V2 / THINKER-19M
families.purpose: Recurrent mixture-of-experts core and NextLat auxiliary
families.status: Paused run with checkpoint evaluation and audits
families.limitations: Checkpoint-matched audit comparisons differ from final V1 test readings.

families.name: V3 / THINKER-19M
families.purpose: Repair gradient flow and resource balance with dense recurrence
families.status: Main final evaluation recorded
families.limitations: The earlier proposal and actual trained model differ. Audit snapshots are not independent replications.

families.name: V4-tiny
families.purpose: Revised pooling, PQ, recurrence, and matched transformer controls
families.status: Pilot and comparison results recorded
families.limitations: Structural contracts and pilot outcomes establish different claims; consult each run's configuration.

families.name: V4.1-tiny
families.purpose: Private token-memory retrieval and concept-dependence controls
families.status: Registered and exploratory comparisons recorded
families.limitations: Post-hoc plan-off controls are exploratory; interventions can introduce distribution shifts.

families.name: V5-tiny
families.purpose: Foundation, latent replacement, persistent control, and repair
families.status: Multiple training and evaluation stages recorded
families.limitations: A report containing planned RL stages does not establish that every stage succeeded or completed.

families.name: V6 / V6.1
families.purpose: Controlled replacement and time-matched latent repair; later search proposal
families.status: V6 pipeline completed; V6.1 remains a separate proposal
families.limitations: Equal-attempt results do not imply an equal-time advantage. The V6.1 draft is not proof of implementation.

families.name: V7-tiny
families.purpose: Independent foundation/refit/control/search queue and flat controls
families.status: Stopped by user with partial results
families.limitations: Saved pipeline tests are engineering evidence; the full scientific queue was interrupted.

families.name: V8 competence pilot
families.purpose: Competence-first foundation and gated downstream work
families.status: Pilot completed; competence gate failed
families.limitations: A completed pilot with a failed gate does not establish success of later planned stages.

families.name: V8 full-exposure revision
families.purpose: Full-exposure diagnostic revision with explicit cache/JSON recoveries
families.status: Extended pilot completed
families.limitations: Recoveries reused foundations within the original budget and are not new independent training seeds. Large result payloads stay local with compact digests.

families.name: V9-tiny
families.purpose: H-NCP hypotheses, concept search, expert iteration, and LSL
families.status: Q1–Q4 evidence; original later queues stopped; reduced Q5 completed
families.limitations: S stages and Q queues differ. Downstream seeds can share one foundation. Reduced Q5 uses unequal budgets and does not establish equal-compute search superiority.

families.name: V10 / V10-10M
families.purpose: RCDL implementation, public-data pretraining, and corpus audit
families.status: Pretraining stopped for transition to V10.1
families.limitations: The original corpus audit records serialized-byte wrappers and restricted math coverage; inherited losses require that context.

families.name: V10.1
families.purpose: Clean corpus, interface contracts, and forecast supervision
families.status: Pretraining stopped for transition; validation recorded
families.limitations: Validation success does not establish completion of the intended 16-hour pretraining budget.

families.name: V10.2
families.purpose: Released concept-history retrieval, integration, and throughput checks
families.status: Implementation and production-smoke evidence recorded
families.limitations: No full scientific pretraining run is inferred from sustained validation or a production-smoke checkpoint.

families.name: V10.3-tiny
families.purpose: Mixture-likelihood exploration, forecast map, codebook fix, and sleep
families.status: Paired training/evaluation and sleep evidence recorded
families.limitations: Use the paired comparisons and registered controls; implementation checks alone are not performance evidence.

families.name: V11-tiny
families.purpose: Code-free two-visit core and concept-anchored prediction bridge
families.status: Multi-arm training and paired comparisons recorded
families.limitations: V11_Paper is an evidence bundle distinct from the v11_Papers literature folder. Frozen predecessors are not new runs.

families.name: V12-tiny
families.purpose: Simpler E→C→D trunk, categorical NCP, and frozen-base controller
families.status: Base and Phase-2 evidence recorded, including aborted work
families.limitations: Keep aborted and pilot runs separate. Inspect Phase-2 logs for each controller stage rather than assuming the whole proposal completed.

families.name: V13-tiny-v2
families.purpose: Calibrated task ladders, concept diagnostics, and continual-learning tests
families.status: Final base evaluation and continual-stage evidence recorded
families.limitations: The preregistration report can retain stale status text. Final checkpoint counts differ from the last periodic log. Single-seed evidence; inspect continual stages separately.

families.name: V14-tiny
families.purpose: EMA multi-horizon targets, throughput shrink, diagnostics, and continual learning
families.status: Base, diagnostic, and continual pipeline completed
families.limitations: REPORT.md still says pre-registered/not yet run. Final evaluation is step 12,977; table header uses the last periodic log. Changes jointly affect targets and model size. Single seed.

families.name: V15 proposal
families.purpose: Frozen hierarchical codec, predictive plans, and concept-depth memory
families.status: Proposed and analytically reviewed; not implemented or trained
families.limitations: The 16 October revision uses completed V14 results and is explicitly post-results. Analytical checks are not model training or evidence of outperforming V14.
